notablePrerequisites: You control at least three untapped creatures.
description:
Activate Prosperous Partnership by tapping three untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers three times, creating three 2/2 Cat creature tokens with haste or three 3/1 Dog creature tokens with vigilance.
Resolve the Prosperous Partnership ability, creating a Treasure token, a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste, or a 3/1 Dog creature token with vigilance.
Repeat.
